topics.title: OpenAI chief scientist proposes perplexity-based limits on frontier AI development
topics.summary: On November 22, 2026, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published internal log-perplexity measurements and proposed binding industry limits tied to pretraining perplexity thresholds until monitoring tools meet concrete safety milestones. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman endorsed the essay, which warned that AI could accelerate its own development as soon as 2027.

topics.title: OpenRouter drops three AI inference providers after Dragos canary study exposes silent prompt breaches
topics.summary: On November 22, 2026, AI router OpenRouter off-boarded three inference providers and stripped 125 endpoints of Zero Data Retention eligibility after a Dragos study seeded nearly two million prompts with canary tokens between July and November 2026. Dragos found undetected breaches at at least three providers and widespread prompt logging.

topics.title: Anthropic closes $93.5 billion IPO and $26 billion private placement as shares slip on day two
topics.summary: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic closed its 1.127 billion-share IPO at $83 a share, including the full 147 million-share underwriter option, raising $93.5 billion in gross proceeds alongside a $26 billion private placement to seven suppliers. Shares slipped on their second day of Nasdaq trading amid a broader tech sell-off.
